title: The Hebrew letter he (ה): value 5, “Behold! Revelation, Open Window”
summary: Teaches the Hebrew letter he (ה): shown in three typefaces and as an ancient pictograph, with the number 5 (H = 5), the meaning “Behold! Revelation, Open Window”, and the note that H becomes “The”.

letters.meaning: behold! revelation, open window; H → the (ancient pictograph of a figure with raised arms)

numbers.note: numerical value of the letter he (ה)

pictures.description: Small ancient (paleo-Hebrew) glyph of the letter he — a stylised figure with raised arms — underlined, placed beside the “H 5” label.
The same ancient glyph of he (figure with raised arms), underlined, drawn large beside the giant numeral 5 and the Latin letter H.

uncertain: Exact typefaces of the three ה letters at top; the three are transcribed simply as ה ה ה
